source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Strict aseptic technique during access cannulation or catheter care, and client education on monitoring for signs of infection","B":"Fairly few precautions actually needed beyond what standard hospital care would already typically provide","C":"Allowing essentially any staff member to access the site without any specific technique requirements in place","D":"Precautions considered relevant mainly for catheter access, rather than for fistulas or grafts as well"}}
source_row.rationale: Dialysis access infection prevention includes strict aseptic technique during access cannulation (for fistulas/grafts) or catheter care, along with client education on monitoring for signs of infection, applicable across all access types given the significant infection risk associated with repeated vascular access.
